results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec
All 58 aligned units' summaries match their spec paragraphs' controlling ideas in spec order; sections, unit counts and forms match (structure.json).

results.quote: Posts from 2018 to 2020, written about these global markets, do show **capabilities built once and run across regional markets**
results.finding: The outliner needed two phrases: the rebranding as brand-only consolidation, and the global-era engineering habit of fitting shared capabilities into the existing engine. The spec's controlling idea joins the two with 'while'; the paragraph states them as two separate claims with no sentence saying what joins them (what the roll-up did and did not share).

results.draft_locus: The Engineering Record: How the Listing Stack Evolved ¶4
results.quote: **The success label is a contact, not a sale**, because a classifieds platform rarely observes the sale
results.finding: The outliner needed two phrases (contact as success label; paid visibility as its own objective). The spec's idea unifies them as 'two choices in OLX's ranker match the book's patterns', but the paragraph opens straight into the first choice and joins the second with 'And', never stating the unifying idea.
Every unit ties to O1-O4 (portfolio sets platform worth; adjacent bets exited; stack evolved in place; dated, uneven record) or to the closing rules derived from them.

results.draft_locus: The Engineering Record: How the Listing Stack Evolved ¶7
results.quote: Propensity-score matching, validated against a randomized experiment, estimated uplifts of 17.6% to 97.4% between package levels.
results.finding: The matched-uplift result is not followed by a sentence saying what it shows (that once self-selection is removed the premium packages outperform, reversing the dashboard view), nor which metric rose; the reader is left to infer the point of the statistic.

Every declared transition_in is expressed at its boundary (e.g. 'While mergers shrank the footprint, OLX bet the other way'; 'Central Asia followed'; 'The Polish overlap is the Veldmark rule the case can point toward but not validate').

results.quote: OLX's adjusted EBIT margin rose from 25% to 35% in one year, and its adjusted EBITDA margin rose eight more points, to 48%, the next
results.finding: Both readers stopped because 35 + 8 is not 48; that the two margins are different measures, and that the eight points are counted from an implied 40% aEBITDA margin, is explained only in the note under the economics table, about 150 lines later.
results.corroborated_by: flow reader B, item B5 (same passage; flow reader A, item A1)

results.quote: OLX answers the question [[case-adevinta]] leaves open
results.finding: Both readers read 'the question [[case-adevinta]] leaves open' as something they were assumed to know and had to infer it from the bolded question that follows; the link is presented as known rather than shown.
results.corroborated_by: flow reader B, item B1 (flow reader A, item A2)

results.quote: ### Brand consolidation, and the global era's engineering (posts of 2018–2020)
results.finding: Both readers were thrown by engineering posts of 2018-2020 inside a phase dated 2006-2018 when the roadmap says the engineering record is read after the phases; nothing in the roadmap or the Phase 1 prose says global-era posts are read with their phase and the Engineering Record covers only OLX Europe (only the Engineering Record's first sentence implies the split). The spec's placement is defensible; the prose does not announce it.
results.corroborated_by: flow reader B, item B2 (flow reader A, item A3)

results.quote: In my reading, South Africa's AutoTrader, a listing business, was never part of OLX Autos.
results.finding: AutoTrader has not been mentioned before; the sentence corrects a confusion the reader never had and sits out of place at the end of the exit paragraph (and frames an ownership fact as 'my reading').
results.corroborated_by: flow reader B, item B4 (flow reader A, item A4)

results.draft_locus: Phase 4: Retreat to a European Core (2022–2026) ¶1
results.quote: On 14 October 2022 Naspers announced the sale of Avito, in which Prosus held an effective 99%
results.finding: Naspers and Prosus (does_not_know: OLX's owners) are both named as owners, but their relation (Prosus as Naspers' listed subsidiary) is never stated, so a reader cannot tell why Naspers sells what Prosus holds. Not reported by a flow reader.
Opens on an intriguing example (the range of portfolio moves) and moves to the question, the era caveat and a roadmap; none of the weak patterns.
Answers the three questions and joins them into one rule, then hands off; no 'in conclusion', no new subtopic, no body evidence.
Joins the three answers into one rule no single section states and draws the actions from it (fund for markets kept, switchable adjacent businesses, stoppable search steps).
Returns to the three questions asked of each phase, in order, and to the portfolio moves of the hook (45 markets to seven; cars, credit, pay-and-ship).

The cold reader predicted the three questions, the evidence (Prosus financials, deal history, OLX engineering posts 2018-2026 read by era and pinned to date and market), the three arguments and the ending with decision rules, the book's patterns and Veldmark.

The answer gives OLX Autos' US$1.6 billion, half of classifieds revenue, losses and the 2023 exit; licensed provider, inventory outside the core, own data boundary and events, per-category flags so closing is a config change; Solr and BM25 kept, vector quota, retrained ranker (keyword ranker under-scored vector and paid results), modest ranker, smaller market's zero-results fallback before the main flow, and a revenue guardrail.

results.quote: Kinesis used for search ingestion of enriched ad events (2024)
results.finding: Statements about how OLX runs systems (Kinesis for search ingestion; 'a Cassandra chat store described by the India-era chat team (2021)') carry a year but no identifiable source, and neither appears in Sources and Evidence, so the facts cannot be traced.
